name: FibraHotel
summary: FibraHotel is a Mexican trust created primarily to develop, acquire, own, and operate hotels in Mexico. Their objective is to provide attractive returns to CBFI holders through distributions and appreciation in the value of our real estate assets. Additionally, the firm will seek to maintain a high-quality hotel portfolio through affiliation with different prestigious brands and operators, as well as geographic diversification and by segments. FibraHotel was established on July 31, 2012 and incorporated in Mexico.
